Hi Logan —

Quick ask from our side: we just ran reconciliation on the Nightstream webinar and noticed the sponsor promo pool you allocated to Broadcaster Media was larger than agreed (you granted 10,000 credits; contract line item says 5,000). Can you revert the extra 5k back to our promo pool and reissue 2k of the remainder as demo credits for the on-demand recording distribution?

We’re on a tight timeline — distribution starts Monday. Happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Thanks,

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for flagging this; apologies for the mismatch. I pulled the allocation log and it looks like an earlier one-off top-up from a pilot run was applied accidentally when the campaign was created. I can revert the extra 5,000 credits back into your event pool and then issue two separate code batches: 3,000 demo credits (for the AM followups) and 2,000 recording-distribution credits, unless you want a different split.

Marissa — adding you to confirm approval for the rollback and to loop in finance for the accounting entry. Marcus, you might want to note the deal ID below for billing reconciliation.

Next steps I propose:
- Logan to request rollback and reissue (I’ll create the credit sheet and send for accounting).
- Marissa to approve the rollback (this needs marketing ops sign-off).
- Marcus to confirm no downstream billing impact or to call out adjustments.

I’ll attach the current allocation snapshot and a draft credit sheet for your review.

Logan

logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 650-555-2222
